name: io.github.iowarp/geojson-mcp
title: CLIO Geojson
description: MCP server for inspecting, validating, and summarizing GeoJSON documents (stdlib only)

tools.name: inspect_geojson
tools.description: Inspect a GeoJSON document and report its geometry types and counts, feature count, property keys (schema), bounding box [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], CRS if present, and total vertex count. Accepts a file path or inline GeoJSON.

tools.name: validate_geojson
tools.description: Validate the structural well-formedness of a GeoJSON document: that the top-level type is recognized and every geometry's type and coordinates are well-formed (correct nesting depth, finite numeric positions). Returns {valid, errors}.

tools.name: summarize_geojson
tools.description: Produce a compact human-readable summary of a GeoJSON document: counts per geometry type, bounding box, property keys, and a few sample feature property sets. Accepts a file path or inline GeoJSON.

tools.name: feature_bbox
tools.description: Compute the overall bounding box [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] of all features in a GeoJSON document. Accepts a file path or inline GeoJSON. Returns the bbox (or null when there are no coordinates) and the feature count.

resources.name: capabilities
resources.description: Describe what the geojson MCP server can do.

prompts.name: inspect_workflow
prompts.description: Guided workflow: validate, then inspect and summarize a GeoJSON document.
